name: Lost Memories
source:
One evening on a rainy day in April Naoto meets a girl who is shivering and looks like a thrown cat. He takes her home. She lost her memory but reacts to the name Alice. As she starts to gradually recover the memory she is confused by memory contents and conflicts. What's the truth behind her past?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
四月的一个雨天晚上，直人遇到了一个浑身发抖、看起来像一只被扔出去的猫的女孩。他带她回家。她失去了记忆，但对爱丽丝这个名字有了反应。当她开始逐渐恢复记忆时，她对记忆内容和冲突感到困惑。她的过去背后的真相是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
